sections.title: Keep test and live separate
sections.excerpt: Keep test and live separate | Use test products for sandbox flows and live products for production flows. Mixing modes is the most common reason checkout setup fails.

sections.title: Create products before attaching them
sections.excerpt: Create products before attaching them | Paywall screens can only sell products that exist here, and every product must match the Stripe mode of the published flow. Create, edit, and delete products from this page.
